title: Code Linter — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature implementation approach, labeled Signature throughout. Signature edition. Original Signature implementation approach, labeled Signature throughout. The Code Linter is one of the 100 writing programs and tools AI should have: the actual programs, software tools, and engines — code editors, compilers, document creators, testing tools — that let an AI create real documents and working software. The key distinction this database honors: a description of a code Linter is not itself a code Linter. So this record carries the ACTUAL working implementation — real code, executed at build time, with verified outputs recorded below.
